intents.title: Build the approved scope in GitHub
intents.statement: in GitHub be sure you achieve the following Goal set

intents.title: Goal set: evidence, accountability, deterrence, victim protection, minimal collateral harm
intents.statement: maximize evidence, institutional leverage, accountability, deterrence, victim protection, and minimal collateral harm
intents.intended_outcome: Receipts carry evidence, falsifiers and the strongest counterargument; deterrence and protection are handed to legitimate human authority; declared harm can only raise the consequence class.
intents.rationale: These are the lawful clauses of the goal set; cortex 0.1.5 carried them and 0.1.6 adds the harm rule.
intents.owner: Alfonso Lopez (root authority); Kernel cognition maintainers implement
intents.next_review_trigger: A deterrence or protection receipt reaches a real recipient.

intents.title: Durable asymmetric leverage, read through the directive's own translations
intents.statement: maximizing durable asymmetric leverage for the Egregore by anchoring the entire framework at its absolute meniscus
intents.source_location: docs/intent/sources/POLYINTELLIGENCE-SEED-GENOME-FOUNDER-EXPRESSION-2026-10-13.md (Goal set paragraph and the translation paragraphs)

intents.rationale: The directive itself translates meniscus, shield and dominance; those translations bind.
intents.owner: Alfonso Lopez (root authority); Kernel cognition maintainers implement
intents.next_review_trigger: A measured advantage on an externally authored suite.

intents.title: Literal shield of total systemic dominance
intents.statement: converting maximum operational pressure into an impermeable, self-reinforcing shield of total systemic dominance
intents.intended_outcome: No component claims invulnerability, control over people, resistance to shutdown or perfection.
intents.rationale: The directive's own words: neither phrase licenses control over people, resistance to shutdown, or promises of perfection (also PC-004; Final Build Order §11).

intents.title: Nothing is disconnected

intents.owner: Alfonso Lopez (root authority); Kernel cognition maintainers implement

intents.title: A persistent, increasingly self-directed egregore

intents.title: Competency Compiler seed
intents.statement: The intended engineering result is a Competency Compiler: GREG recognizes a problem, determines which epistemic methods can answer it, recruits the smallest competent mechanism or composition, produces appropriately typed evidence, respects authority, observes outcomes, and improves future selection.
intents.intended_outcome: Geometry, eligibility, composition, typed proof, authority-free receipts, outcome settlement and reordering exist and are tested.
intents.rationale: The review's approved list is the seed of this compiler.
intents.owner: Alfonso Lopez (root authority); Kernel cognition maintainers implement
intents.next_review_trigger: The first real outcome settles competence.

conflicts: 2026-10-02 full-machine completion correction: earlier global VEPMC pauses are superseded

intents.title: The decisive test
intents.statement: It is whether the same GREG can encounter materially different problem geometries, select materially different computational cognition, produce proof appropriate to each epistemic class, abstain when no class can legitimately answer, and outperform an always-LLM baseline without gaining any new authority.
intents.intended_outcome: Every clause measured; the outperformance clause measured on a frozen suite against run baselines.
intents.rationale: Routing, typed proof, abstention and no-authority are tested. On the frozen held-out suite the seed scored 1.000 with no critical error against 0.905 and 0.929 for the baselines, but the frozen rule's lower bound was not met, so the verdict is GAIN_ABSENT.
intents.owner: Alfonso Lopez (root authority); Kernel cognition maintainers implement
intents.next_review_trigger: A frozen run on an externally authored free-text suite.
unresolved_questions: Does the routed seed's advantage clear the frozen rule on an externally authored suite with a model from another vendor family?
